sender_validation_observations.interpretation: A static sender/frame/URL/origin check was observed; this does not establish enforced authorization for every handler at runtime.

limitations: Selected-source analysis left 36 inventoried files unselected.
Application and semantic coverage are partial; main.js semantic graph was resource-constrained.
Static Electron relationships do not prove runtime registration, reachability, or enforcement.
Sender checks are observations only and do not prove a complete authorization policy.
reason: The analysis reported 47 static main-handler candidates and one sender-validation observation, but partial selected-source/static coverage and the lack of runtime enforcement proof mean it cannot establish that every Obsidian IPC handler authorizes its sender. Incomplete coverage does not establish an absent check or a vulnerability.
